text: Maya: saw sampleapp show raw gateway 'ServiceError: upstream reset' to users. Can we make that friendlier? Owen: agreed. Is that coming from gateway or SDK? Maya: SDK forwards gateway message verbatim into message field; no typed mapping. Sophie: we should map into AuthError / TransientError / QuotaError / ClientError. For 5xx use 'Temporary service issue — please retry'. Include retry-after when present. Javi: callers need programmatic signals, not string matching. Add helpers like isRetryable(err) and retryHint(err). Maya: plan: SDK message becomes short UX copy; raw gateway text kept in err.raw; add hint field. Example proto: if status >=500 return TransientError(message: 'Temporary service disruption', raw: gatewayMsg, retryable: true). Owen: drop change into sampleapp so UI tests can assert toast copy vs logs. Maya: will add unit test that simulates 502 and checks err.message includes 'Temporary service disruption' and err.raw includes 'upstream reset'. infra-bot: deploy scheduled sampleapp/tests -> staging at 15:30 UTC. Sophie: docs update needed with migration notes and examples. Javi: streaming edge case: partial stream errors should emit typed error events, not raw strings. Maya: including streaming mapping in PR. Owen: action items: Maya PR + test; Sophie docs snippet; Javi helper API proposal; Owen UI test. Maya: PR posted github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/412 — ready for review. Owen: reviewing now, thanks!
